# Wholesale Squishy

> US wholesale supplier of squishy toys sold by the case (6 to 24 pieces per case) to retailers, gift and novelty shops, scoop/vending machine operators and procurement buyers. Ships from South Gate, California; orders processed immediately, delivery within 5 working days. US shipping only.

## Key facts
- No minimum order value: the smallest order is one case (6 to 24 pieces), mix any styles.
- Volume pricing by total pieces in the order: 50+ pcs 6.2% off, 100+ 9.9%, 250+ 12%, 500+ 12.9%, 1000+ 13.5%.
- Shipping: about $12 + $2.50 per case (ground, tracked). Free standard shipping on orders from $5,000 to $15,000. Freight quoted separately above $15,000.
- Payment: card via Stripe checkout. Larger orders: request a quote.
- Returns: 30 days from delivery; see the return policy.
- Contact: support@wholesalesquishy.com. Address: 12508 Center St, Suite 5, South Gate, CA 90280.
